comparisonSummary: 1 direct computed sample(s) paired, with 0 stable-field differences. Read the comparison JSON for exact scope; screenshot age text and source duration are not identity/performance claims.
limits: This compares the specified genuine revisions and selected observed paths. It does not claim global pixel identity, exhaustive UI coverage, or a speed/performance improvement.

Recordings use their existing 25 fps cadence without editorial speed changes. The recorder caps an initial unchanged lead-in at one second and holds the final still at least one second. Capture-clock and encoded durations are retained per source.

Labelled detail scenes are actual source crops after full-viewport context leads. Held screenshots are labelled as stills in captions and provenance; full unmodified selected PNGs and MP4s remain downloadable.
No model message, real credentials, login, provider connection, paid API or paid resource was used. The genuine unconfigured-model warning remains visible.
Representative all-five-theme screenshots do not imply every scenario/theme/viewport combination was tested.
Before source neutral-desktop-sidebar.mp4 reports 1 capture miss(es); no guarantee is made that every motion frame was captured.
Desktop source durations differ because the real interactions and capture waits differ; they are not performance measurements.

The main film covers the changed collapsed desktop rail. Expanded Light+ phone evidence is explicitly unchanged-path smoke with one owned idle Overview width check row and Getting started 1 complete; desktop captures precede that arrangement and have empty history.
Old transitional phone stills, the generic two-DOM-copy selector failure recording, and the After title-toast attempt remain excluded from public selected sources.
